purpose: Resolve the V29 warm/dry mechanism on a common REA-L grid before one correction is selected.

common_grid.hicar_sampling: nearest 200 m active-soil HICAR cell for each target cell; report distance distribution
common_grid.mask: finite REA-L SKT and 0-1.5 m W_SO plus mapped HICAR active-soil cell
common_grid.area_weighting: cos(latitude) on the common target grid

time_alignment.hicar_flux: composite trapezoidal mean of seven 30-minute endpoint samples over the same interval

decision_rule.cloud_first: cloud deficit <= -0.05 and rain deficit <= -0.05 kg m-2 begin before land divergence
decision_rule.land_first: absolute HICAR-minus-REA-L change from initial reaches >= 1 K in skin temperature or >= 3 kg m-2 in 0-1.5 m soil water before cloud deficit
decision_rule.simultaneous_or_no_order: authorize a predeclared two-arm discriminating correction pair; do not report an observationally inconclusive scientific outcome

next_authorization: one selected correction after a leading pathway or the discriminating pair identifies it; only a passing frozen 72-hour summer gate can resume seasonal validation
